label: Thief rerun (stopped T24 at 29-29: tie, stale-sighting harness bug)

scenario.description: Seed-20261106 mirror-symmetric board: 21x17 grid, 6 control points, 4 resource nodes, 2 deliver + 4 hold mission(s). 180-degree rotational symmetry — team spawns and every objective mirror through the center, so both teams face an identical board. Roster: 1 scout + 2 harvester(s) + 2 defender(s) + 1 thief(s) per team (6 units). Each team delivers at its own spawn corner, for its own deliver mission. An owned control point watches every cell within 2 of it for its owner, from capture until it is captured back. The Crown sits on the center cell: 4 points to the first team to hold it alone for 6 consecutive turns. Early end: an out-of-reach lead ends the match; so does a lead of at least 50% of the most the gap could still close by, held 3 turns in a row from turn 20.

reason: Stopped at turn 24, 29–29, and called a tie: stale enemy sightings were shown as current.
